key: original body.data bond ID, immutable atom tags, type, zero periodic image
collision_policy: duplicate endpoint pairs and periodic geometry rejected before computation; no ambiguous periodic image support claimed
m: frozen reference by immutable atom tag, independent of local slots
history: one replicated kappa/d/failed record per original undirected ID; two independent internal endpoint-star values
MPI: owned-coordinate Allreduce with exactly one owner per immutable tag; ghosts excluded from gather; same accepted collective token and deterministic history on each rank; global counters are not summed over replicas
force: Each rank adds force only on owned native atoms. Global full energy appears once in native tally.
topology: On accepted d=1 transition remove from owned per-atom bond arrays, remove 1-2 special exclusions, retain failed global record, update nbonds. Subsequent run0 rebuilds neighbors before pair contact.
restart: Native bond payload LPSVAR_RESTART_V1 stores full original graph including failed records, fixed m, r,taper,V, params,kappa,d,failed,D,event count,token and last accepted coordinates; exact double roundtrip
